participants.name: Coding agent
participants.responsibility: Changes code in any repository on the laptop: fixes, features, tests, reviews. Not for notes or research. Examples: 'Fix the failing build in the router repo', 'Add a test for the config loader'.

participants.name: Notes agent
participants.responsibility: Notes, research and synthesis in the vault on the desk machine. Not for code changes. Examples: 'Summarize what we decided about the board', 'Draft a note on the eval procedure'.

agents.coder@laptop: paste the agent id from `paseo agent ls --json`
agents.notes@desk: paste the agent id from `paseo --host ssh://desk agent ls --json`
